title: Regulatory Capital Rule: Large Banking Organization Capital Standards
summary: Federal banking agencies propose revisions to the risk-based capital framework, often described as the Basel III endgame, for large banking organizations. The proposal applies to bank holding companies and depository institutions above a size threshold.
full_text: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, together with the other federal banking agencies, proposes revisions to the risk-based regulatory capital framework, often described as the Basel III endgame, applicable to large banking organizations. The proposal would change how covered banking organizations calculate risk-weighted assets and the amount of regulatory capital they must maintain against those assets. It applies to bank holding companies and insured depository institutions that exceed the specified asset threshold.
